g.title: crate Standard UI components with theme support.
crate::alert Present persistent alerts and dismissible feedback banners.
crate::async_view Display the loading, success and retry states of async operations.
crate::avatar Display reactive person images with initials and semantic status fallback.
crate::avatar_group Lay out a bounded facepile with the shared roving-focus owner.
crate::avatar_initials Derive first and last name initials while retaining joined Unicode glyphs.
crate::avatar_tokens Passive theme data for avatar.
crate::badge Compose a semantic badge with icons and optional activation.
crate::breadcrumb Render keyed breadcrumb navigation with one current page.
crate::button Build the themed button from a momentary toggle part.
crate::button_group Group arbitrary action controls into one native roving focus scope.
crate::button_tokens Passive theme data for button.
crate::calendar Gregorian calendar with shared keyboard and range-selection behavior.
crate::calendar::caption Locale-backed month names and calendar caption controls.
crate::calendar::navigation Month navigation announcements and touch swipe ownership.
crate::calendar::panel One month of the calendar: caption, weekday row and day cells.
crate::calendar::state State shared by the calendar's month panels.
crate::calendar::view The Calendar builder and the month panels view it builds.
crate::calendar_tokens Calendar measurements that kits can override in the theme.
crate::calendar_values Define passive calendar captions, event marks and day recipe projections.
crate::card Compose plain, pressable, or selectable card surfaces.
crate::carousel Render binding-driven translated or native scrolling carousels.
crate::carousel_geometry Resolve measured native carousel page navigation without retaining geometry.
crate::carousel_tokens Optional carousel visual overrides supplied by kit themes.
crate::carousel_values Define passive carousel presentation modes and recipe projections.
crate::chat_composer Submit multiline drafts through keyboard and send/stop controls.
crate::chat_message Assemble a named chat message with caller supplied content and metadata.
crate::chat_thread Keep a semantic message log attached to growing content through follow-end.
crate::chat_tokens Define passive timing and metrics for chat and source-code surfaces.
crate::chat_values Define passive chat meanings and theme states.
crate::code_block Present selectable code with syntax, numbering and clipboard feedback.
crate::code_editing Apply source-line emphasis and native read-only code navigation.
crate::code_gutter Project source line numbers onto the native editor's shaped visual rows.
crate::code_values Read-only actual construction facts for source-code recipes.
crate::collection_values Define passive layout projections and theme metrics for collections.
crate::column_values Define passive column text, cell content, ordering and sizing inputs.
crate::combobox Expose the themed combobox family and its visual tokens.
crate::combobox::data Hold passive combobox construction inputs shared by configuration and rendering.
crate::combobox::handle Configure the standard keyed combobox family.
crate::combobox::labels Retain only labels needed by selected keys across changing result sources.
crate::combobox::look Default themed recipes for the combobox family.
crate::combobox::notices Announce accepted multiple-selection edits without mirroring selection.
crate::combobox::render Render one combobox query and selection through themed editor and list parts.
crate::combobox::tokens Store combobox visual dimensions overridden by official kits.
crate::command_palette Render a themed command palette over the shared palette behavior.
crate::component_values Describe passive semantic projections supplied to component recipes.
crate::composer_history Own submitted drafts and recall transitions without duplicating editor state.
crate::data_column Attach menu builders to passive table column header contracts.
crate::data_table A standard keyed data table composes the one interaction model and table.
crate::data_table::builder The data table's constructor and the options a caller turns on.
crate::data_table::chrome The default regions of a data table: filter field, summary, pager, check boxes.
crate::data_table::column_keys Identify table accessory columns independently of rendering.
crate::data_table::filter_value Describe typed table filter editors and validate their values.
crate::data_table::filters Render typed filters in table headers and commit validated drafts.
crate::data_table::grouped Group already sorted and paged data without adding synthetic data keys.
crate::data_table::metadata Derive full logical table coordinates without copying caller state.
crate::data_table::navigation Link mounted group rows into the grid's logical keyboard order.
crate::data_table::row_drag Decide where a dragged data-table row is and when it moves one place.
crate::data_table::row_status Named status markers in the table's leading accessory lane.
crate::data_table::rows Render keyed header and body cells with the table's actual part states.
crate::data_table::runtime Configure one shared model and table and compose the retained regions.
crate::data_table::sticky_paint Theme policy and paint for sticky data table cells.
crate::data_table::tree Arrange hierarchical table rows and render their disclosure controls.
crate::data_table::types The state of a data table: its builder fields, slots and live context.
crate::data_table_tokens Passive data table theme paint and token definitions.
crate::date_input Locale-sensitive date editing with a calendar or a touch sheet.
crate::date_input::machine Date draft, validation and picker lifetime transitions.
crate::date_input::view Build an editable date and its keyboard-accessible picker.
crate::date_input_tokens Passive theme measurements of the touch date and time wheels.
crate::date_range_draft Own typed range endpoint candidates while the public binding stays ordered.
crate::date_range_input Ordered date-range editing, presets and shared range calendar.
crate::date_sheet Immediate date selection with a sheet-owned month/year panel.
crate::date_time_input Date and time editing with one explicit active picker panel.
crate::date_time_model Own the active date-time picker panel and accepted endpoint bindings.
crate::date_time_sheet Route touch date and time fields through one picker controller.
crate::date_trigger Preserve a caller-owned trigger for date-field dialog presentation.
crate::date_wheel Date and wall-clock wheels share scalar keyboard, pointer and assistive editing.
crate::description_list Pair visible terms with arbitrary details in a semantic list.
crate::dialog Render themed dialog frames while shared parts own their lifetime.
crate::dialog_tokens Passive theme data for dialog.
crate::disclosure Build the themed disclosure, a trigger over content it shows and hides.
crate::disclosure_group Render accordion panels over one headless selection controller.
crate::disclosure_values Expose actual disclosure input and passive accordion position to theme recipes.
crate::drawer_swipe Attach velocity-aware dismissal to a drawer's dedicated drag handle.
crate::dropzone Render a native file drop target with validation and optional picking.
crate::dropzone_tokens Optional drop target visual overrides supplied by kit themes.
crate::empty_state Build accessible empty messages with opt-in announcements.
crate::empty_state_changes Observe actual empty-message eligibility and publish accepted changes.
crate::field Wire a visible label, hint and error to the control of a form field.
crate::group_look Default recipes for passive action group layout snapshots.
crate::group_types Passive layout snapshots and tokens shared by action group recipes.
crate::heading Build semantic headings with theme-owned typography.
crate::helpers Share text styles used by standard control labels.
crate::hover_card Render a themed delayed preview attached to a caller-owned trigger.
crate::hover_card_values Define passive preview recipe projections and overlay geometry.
crate::indicator_values Define passive indicator states and theme metrics.
crate::input_group Group labelled controls and their inline or block adornments.
crate::input_group_context Observe the existing input-group projection from deferred descendant scopes.
crate::item_context Provide immutable direct-child list positions and appearance defaults.
crate::item_list Compose semantic static lists with fixed child positions and header content.
crate::item_row Attach canonical row input and render independent item content slots.
crate::kbd Present literal and typed shortcuts with platform command-key glyphs.
crate::kbd_labels Normalize literal and typed shortcuts to localized keyboard key caps.
crate::kbd_values Supply passive key-cap glyphs and spoken labels to theme recipes.
crate::layer Apply theme recipe styles before caller overrides without extra nodes.
crate::list Render a themed selectable list over the shared keyed list parts.
crate::look The default recipes: the core's look, made only of the theme's tokens.
crate::look_calendar Theme recipes of the calendar and date/time input surfaces.
crate::look_chat Supply token-based default chat, typing and code recipes.
crate::look_collections Default recipes for the list and the data table.
crate::look_controls Default recipes for the radio group, slider, toasts and splitter.
crate::look_extra Default recipes for standard multi-part components.
crate::look_feedback Supply token-based default feedback, card and input-group recipes.
crate::look_files Supply default carousel and drop target recipes from theme values.
crate::look_indicators Supply theme-based default indicator geometry and drawing.
crate::look_input Default recipes for the tag input and the number input.
crate::look_metrics Supply theme-based default recipes for metrics and description pairs.
crate::look_navigation Style navigation parts from the theme and passive metrics.
crate::look_palette Default recipes for the command palette.
crate::look_radio Draw the standard segmented radio group variant.
crate::look_static_collections Default theme recipes for static tables and item lists.
crate::menu Render themed menus recursively over shared menu level parts.
crate::navigation_context Share one existing navigation panel's immutable close request and appearance.
crate::navigation_link Render rich navigation links using the closest existing panel's close request.
crate::navigation_menu Compose exclusive navigation panels around the canonical navigation machine.
crate::navigation_tokens Supply passive navigation spacing and control metrics.
crate::navigation_values Define passive semantic status and responsive step recipe projections.
crate::number_input Render a themed number field with decrease and increase buttons.
crate::pagination Render stable keyed page controls and an atomic editable page draft.
crate::pagination_draft Own editable one-based page text and commit it atomically.
crate::progress Build the themed progress bar from its value and the motion it shows.
crate::progress_tokens Passive theme data for progress.
crate::radio_group Render a themed radio group over the shared keyed list parts.
crate::recipes Passive function tables define every standard component's theme recipes.
crate::select Render a themed select using the shared keyed selection parts.
crate::select::handle Render a themed select using the shared keyed selection parts.
crate::select::machine Recognize a touch sheet tap without duplicating select surface state.
crate::selection_field Present caller-owned chooser content in a popup or touch drawer.
crate::selector_presentation Choose touch surfaces for keyed selection components.
crate::skeleton Render loading placeholders and pause their clock for reduced motion.
crate::slider Render themed sliders over the shared scalar track and thumb parts.
crate::spinner Display a localized loading status with one animation.
crate::split Render panes sized by fractions with a themed splitter handle between each pair.
crate::splitter Render two themed panes and the shared splitter handle between them.
crate::stat Present a named statistic with optional delta, icon and chart slots.
crate::stepper Render reactive progress steps with semantic current-step metadata.
crate::switch_drag Opt-in direct manipulation for a standard switch.
crate::switch_drag::geometry Resolve switch thumb travel and rubber-band geometry.
crate::switch_drag::handle Attach a switch gesture machine and publish its recipe projection.
crate::switch_drag::machine Decide switch direct manipulation and owner-scoped release timing.
crate::table Compose static tables with themed rows and cells.
crate::table_values Define passive table group projections and row-status descriptors.
crate::tabs Render a shared themed tab list with optional selected panel lifetime.
crate::tag_input Render a themed field of removable tags and a text input to add one.
crate::time_input Wall-clock text editing and adaptive scalar wheels.
crate::time_input::machine Validate time text and store exactly one draft phase.
crate::time_input::view Time field and its wheel dialog.
crate::time_parse Parse wall-clock text independently of mounted field controllers.
crate::toast Render the App's toasts in themed live regions.
crate::toast_swipe Opt-in touch and pen swipes for standard toast cards.
crate::toast_swipe::handle Attach the toast swipe machine and its visual dismissal to the card.
crate::toast_swipe::machine Decide raw touch swipe intent and release outcomes.
crate::toast_swipe::machine::tests Check swipe intent and dismissal thresholds.
crate::toast_tokens Passive theme data for toast.
crate::toggle Build themed binary toggles from their actual interaction part state.
crate::toggle_button Build the themed toggle_button button from its actual interaction part state.
crate::toggle_button_tokens Passive theme data for toggle button.
crate::toggle_group Compose keyed toggle buttons over the caller's canonical selection.
crate::toggle_parts Mount persistent themeable indicator parts for checkbox and switch motion.
crate::tokens Group per-component visual tokens in one theme extension.
crate::toolbar Compose named toolbar regions with native roving focus.
crate::toolbar_look Derive toolbar layout and divider styles from passive theme metrics.
crate::tooltip Style shared tooltip surface and trigger parts without owning timers.
crate::tree Draw a themed tree using the shared row navigation and expansion parts.
crate::tree_values Read-only tree-row facts available to theme recipes and marker slots.
crate::typing_indicator Present a localized typing status with a theme-controlled animation.
crate::values Passive state and appearance settings for standard component recipes.
crate::variants Kit-defined variants every standard component passes to its recipes.
